children: Livestock futures settle lower, with live cattle futures closing up 0.5% to $2.221 a pound while lean hog futures close down 0.7% to 68.975 cents a pound. For hogs, the movement of the day was a surprise to analysts, with gains expected after a seemingly friendly quarterly supply report from the USDA. The USDA will release its Cold Storage report at 3 p.m. eastern time, which will detail red meat stocks held in freezers. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
